name: miaomiao-bar
description: A macOS clipboard workbench for text and images: whatever lands on the clipboard leaves as something you can paste right away. 喵喵剪贴板：macOS 上的剪贴板工作台，文字和图片进了剪贴板就变成能直接用的样子。
author: Martin

scripts.dev: node tools/write-site-origin.cjs && concurrently -k -n VITE,ELECTRON -c cyan,magenta "vite" "wait-on tcp:5199 && VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5199 electron ."
scripts.dist: node tools/write-site-origin.cjs && npm run dist:arm64 && npm run dist:x64 && npm run clean
